import json, urllib.request, time
while True:
    with urllib.request.urlopen('https://unitreex-test.vercel.app/api/race') as r:
        race=json.load(r)
    sl=race.get('secondsLeft')
    print('epoch', race.get('epoch'), 'left', sl, 'leader', race.get('leader'), 'mission', (race.get('mission') or {}).get('id'))
    if sl is None or sl <= 0:
        break
    time.sleep(min(20, max(2, sl+1)))

addr='0x2f689c62d83564cec6e3bd730507f4fb2200d4fe'
epoch=1987146
req=urllib.request.Request(
    'https://unitreex-test.vercel.app/api/claim',
    data=json.dumps({'address':addr,'epoch':epoch}).encode(),
    headers={'content-type':'application/json'},
    method='POST',
)
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        print('CLAIM', r.status)
        print(r.read().decode())
except Exception as e:
    print('CLAIM ERR', getattr(e,'code',None))
    print(e.read().decode() if hasattr(e,'read') else e)
